title: Can we prevent school shootings? With Dewey Cornell, PhD

sentences.en: From Columbine to Sandy Hook to Parkland to Uvalde, the list of schools and communities devastated by gun violence grows every year.
sentences.zh: 从科伦拜恩到桑迪胡克，再到帕克兰和尤瓦尔迪，每年因枪支暴力而满目疮痍的学校和社区名单都在不断增加。

sentences.en: Every time a school shooting is in the news, it's easy to wonder what, if anything, could have been done differently.
sentences.zh: 每当新闻中报道校园枪击事件时，人们很容易去琢磨：如果当时采取了不同的做法，哪怕只是一点点，结果会不会有所不同？

sentences.en: Were there signs that were missed?
sentences.zh: 是否曾有过被忽视的迹象？

sentences.en: At what point, if any, could or should someone have intervened?
sentences.zh: 在哪个时间点上，某人本可以也应该进行干预？

sentences.en: Psychologists who study school violence have been researching these questions.
sentences.zh: 研究校园暴力的心理学家们一直在研究这些问题。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to talk about what they've found.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来谈谈他们的发现。

sentences.en: So how common is gun violence in schools?
sentences.zh: 那么，校园枪击暴力到底有多普遍？

sentences.en: How do most schools deal with the threat of violence right now?
sentences.zh: 目前大多数学校是如何应对暴力威胁的？

sentences.en: How can teachers, administrators, and law enforcement officials tell real threats of violence from false alarms or pranks?
sentences.zh: 教师、行政人员和执法官员如何区分真正的暴力威胁与虚假警报或恶作剧？

sentences.en: When a real threat is identified, what kind of interventions work?
sentences.zh: 当确认存在真实威胁时，什么样的干预措施才有效？

sentences.en: And how can schools avoid underreacting to genuine threats and overreacting to false ones?
sentences.zh: 学校又该如何避免对真实威胁反应不足以及对虚假威胁反应过度？

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association that examines the links between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学说话》，这是美国心理协会的旗舰播客，主要探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: My guest today is Dr. Dewey Cornell.
sentences.zh: 我今天的嘉宾是杜威·康奈尔博士。

sentences.en: Dr. Cornell is a forensic clinical psychologist and the Virgil S.
sentences.zh: 康奈尔博士是一位法医临床心理学家，也是弗吉尼亚大学的维吉尔·S·

sentences.en: Ward Professor of Education at the University of Virginia, where he directs the Virginia Youth Violence Project.
sentences.zh: 沃德教育学教授，并在该校领导弗吉尼亚青年暴力项目。

sentences.en: He is the principal author of the Comprehensive School Threat Assessment Guidelines,
sentences.zh: 他是《综合学校威胁评估指南》的主要作者，

sentences.en: which is an evidence-based model of school threat assessment used in schools across the United States and Canada.
sentences.zh: 这是一套在美国和加拿大的学校中广泛使用的基于证据的学校威胁评估模型。

sentences.en: He is currently directing a national study of school threat assessment with funding from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他目前正获得美国司法部的资助，

sentences.en: Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 领导一项关于学校威胁评估的国家级研究。

sentences.en: Dr. Cornell has authored more than 300 publications in psychology and education, including studies of juvenile homicide, school safety, bullying, and threat assessment.
sentences.zh: 康奈尔博士在心理学和教育学领域发表了300多篇出版物，其中包括关于青少年谋杀、校园安全、欺凌和威胁评估的研究。

sentences.en: Dr. Cornell, thank you for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 康奈尔博士，非常感谢您今天能来参加节目。

sentences.en: Thank you for inviting me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您的邀请。

sentences.en: Before we start talking about threat assessment, which I want to do, let's put this discussion in some context.
sentences.zh: 在我们开始讨论威胁评估之前——这也是我想谈的——让我们先把这场讨论放在一定的背景中。

sentences.en: This episode won't air until January, but today we're talking right now in late December, the day after another school shooting, this one in Madison, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 这一期节目要到一月份才会播出，但我们今天录制的时间是在十二月下旬，就在又一起校园枪击事件发生后的第二天，这次的地点在威斯康星州麦迪逊市。

sentences.en: So the topic feels especially important right now.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个时候，这个话题显得格外重要。

sentences.en: In this atmosphere, it's hard for students and their parents not to feel worried about sending their kids to school every day.
sentences.zh: 在这种氛围下，学生和家长很难不对每天送孩子去上学感到担忧。

sentences.en: So I want to start with the question, how common is gun violence in U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此我想从这个问题开始：美国的枪击暴力有多普遍，

sentences.en: schools, and how worried should students and parents be about the threat of school shootings?
sentences.zh: 学生和家长对校园枪击威胁到底该有多担心？

sentences.en: That's a very important question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: And certainly when we've had another tragic shooting like we've just had this week, it's very hard not to feel that schools are not safe places,
sentences.zh: 当然，当我们遭遇了像本周这样又一起悲剧性的枪击事件时，人们很难不觉得学校不是安全的地方，

sentences.en: that gun violence seems to be pervasive.
sentences.zh: 觉得枪击暴力似乎无处不在。

sentences.en: And parents, understandably, are very worried about sending their children to school.
sentences.zh: 家长们担心把孩子送去学校，这也是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: But I want to offer a little bit of reassurance there.
sentences.zh: 但我希望能给大家吃一颗定心丸。

sentences.en: On the one hand, gun violence is a very serious problem in the United States, but it's actually less frequent in schools than it is outside of schools.
sentences.zh: 一方面，枪击暴力在美国是一个非常严重的问题，但它在学校发生的频率实际上比在学校之外要低。

sentences.en: And that statistically speaking, we have 130,000 schools, even though we've had a number of school shootings, the average school is very unlikely to ever have a homicide shooting.
sentences.zh: 从统计学上讲，我们有13万所学校，尽管我们确实发生过不少校园枪击案，但平均每所学校发生凶杀枪击案的概率微乎其微。

sentences.en: It calculates out about once every 6,000 years.
sentences.zh: 算下来大约每6000年才会发生一次。

sentences.en: So although it seems counterintuitive, schools are statistically one of the safest places from gun violence in the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管这听起来有些反直觉，但从统计数据来看，美国的学校是遭受枪击暴力侵害最安全的地方之一。

sentences.en: We have more gun violence in our stores and restaurants and parks and parking lots and in our homes by a large margin than we have in schools.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们在商店、餐馆、公园、停车场以及家里的枪击暴力要多得多。

sentences.en: So don't get me wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以，请不要误解我的意思。

sentences.en: School shootings are a terrible tragedy.
sentences.zh: 校园枪击案是一场可怕的悲剧。

sentences.en: We have to do everything we can to prevent them.
sentences.zh: 我们必须尽一切努力去阻止它们。

sentences.en: But statistically, schools are much safer than it feels.
sentences.zh: 但从统计数据来看，学校比我们感觉到的要安全得多。

sentences.en: Around the beginning of this school year, after the shooting at Appalachee High School in Georgia, there was a surge in violent threats against schools nationwide.
sentences.zh: 大约在新学期开始时，在佐治亚州阿巴拉契科技高中枪击案发生后，全美范围内针对学校的暴力威胁激增。

sentences.en: These were really disruptive, in some cases, closing schools for days.
sentences.zh: 这些威胁造成了极大的干扰，在某些情况下甚至导致学校关停数日。

sentences.en: Do surges like this usually follow high-profile shootings?
sentences.zh: 这种激增通常会紧随备受关注的枪击事件发生吗？

sentences.en: And when they do, how can schools and law enforcement tell serious threats from pranks or copycats?
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，学校和执法部门如何区分严肃的威胁与恶作剧或模仿行为？

sentences.en: Yes, after a school shooting, we do see a surge in student threats, but we also see a surge in sensitivity to threats.
sentences.zh: 是的，在发生校园枪击事件后，我们确实会看到学生发出的威胁激增，但我们也会看到人们对威胁的敏感度激增。

sentences.en: So statements and behaviors that might otherwise have been ignored or handled informally become more concerning in the wake of a school shooting to school authorities and to law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 因此，在校园枪击事件发生后，学校当局和执法人员对那些原本可能被忽视或非正式处理的言论和行为会变得更加关切。

sentences.en: So they also react strongly.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们的反应也会很强烈。

sentences.en: So we have both students being stimulated by school shootings to say and do threatening things,
sentences.zh: 所以一方面是校园枪击事件刺激了学生去说和做具有威胁性的事情，

sentences.en: and we have authorities who are on edge and worried and reacting strongly to student behavior.
sentences.zh: 另一方面是当局处于高度紧张和担忧状态，对学生的行为反应强烈。

sentences.en: As I said a minute ago, schools statistically will almost never have an actual shooting or an actual homicide, not in thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 正如我刚才所说，从统计学上讲，学校几乎永远不会发生真正的枪击或真正的凶杀案，几千年都不会有。

sentences.en: But every school has threats.
sentences.zh: 但每所学校都会面临威胁。

sentences.en: Schools frequently deal with students who say or do things that are threatening or concerning in some way.
sentences.zh: 学校经常需要处理那些说出或做出某种威胁性或令人担忧言行的学生。

sentences.en: So it's a pervasive problem.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个普遍存在的问题。

sentences.en: At the same time, the worst possible outcome is very unlikely.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，最糟糕的结果发生的可能性非常小。

sentences.en: And so that creates a real dilemma for schools.
sentences.zh: 这就给学校带来了真正的两难境地。

sentences.en: What do we do with students who make threatening statements?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何处理那些发出威胁性言论的学生？

sentences.en: And that leads us to the comprehensive school threat assessment guidelines that you were involved in in creating.
sentences.zh: 这就引导我们走向了您曾参与创立的《综合学校威胁评估指南》。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about those guidelines and how does this model of threat assessment work?
sentences.zh: 您能给我们讲讲这些指南以及这种威胁评估模型是如何运作的吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So threat assessment is a form of violence prevention that was originally developed by the Secret Service to protect public figures.
sentences.zh: 威胁评估是一种暴力预防形式，最初由特勤局为保护公众人物而开发。

sentences.en: But within a few years, folks began to realize that the general principles of behavioral threat assessment and management, that's the formal term for it,
sentences.zh: 但在几年内，人们开始意识到行为威胁评估与管理（这是它的正式名称）的一般原则，

sentences.en: could be used to prevent workplace violence, domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 可以用来预防职场暴力和家庭暴力。

sentences.en: And as we started to see shootings in schools increase in the 90s, the FBI and Secret Service said, hey, why don't we try this in schools to prevent school shootings?
sentences.zh: 随着我们在90年代看到校园枪击案增加，联邦调查局（FBI）和特勤局说，嘿，为什么我们不尝试在学校里用这个来预防校园枪击呢？

sentences.en: And that's when I went from a meeting with the FBI back to Charlottesville to the University of Virginia.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我从与FBI开会的地方回到了夏洛茨维尔的弗吉尼亚大学。

sentences.en: And I talked with my students and colleagues and I said, hey, let's let's try to develop something.
sentences.zh: 我和我的学生及同事们商量，嘿，让我们尝试开发点什么吧。

sentences.en: And so we work with a group of local educators, folks in the trenches, in the classroom, in the hallways to say,
sentences.zh: 于是，我们与一群当地的教育工作者合作，也就是那些身处一线、在教室和走廊里工作的人，探讨：

sentences.en: how do we deal with students who make threatening statements in a way that's going to be reasonable and fair, safe and avoid the two errors of threat assessment?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何处理那些发出威胁性言论的学生，才能做到既合理、公平、安全，又能避免威胁评估的两种错误？

sentences.en: The two errors are overreaction to threats that are not serious and underreaction to the rare threats that are truly serious where someone poses a serious threat.
sentences.zh: 这两种错误是：对并不严重的威胁反应过度，以及对真正构成严重威胁的罕见情况反应不足。

sentences.en: And so we developed a set of guidelines.
sentences.zh: 于是我们制定了一套指南。

sentences.en: We worked with local schools.
sentences.zh: 我们与当地学校合作。

sentences.en: We tested them.
sentences.zh: 我们对它们进行了测试。

sentences.en: We refined them.
sentences.zh: 我们对它们进行了完善。

sentences.en: We developed a manual.
sentences.zh: 我们编写了一本手册。

sentences.en: And then we did all the stuff that academics do.
sentences.zh: 然后我们做了所有学者都会做的事情。

sentences.en: That is, we conducted a series of studies and went out and got grants and developed a training program and so forth.
sentences.zh: 也就是，我们开展了一系列研究，去申请了资助，开发了培训项目等等。

sentences.en: So in the real world, what does this feel like?
sentences.zh: 那么在现实世界中，这感觉是怎样的？

sentences.en: What does it look like?
sentences.zh: 它看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: So if I'm a school administrator and I'm following the threat assessment guidelines, how do I make the judgment that this is a serious threat or this is not a serious threat?
sentences.zh: 如果我是一名学校管理者，并且我正在遵循威胁评估指南，我该如何判断这究竟是一个严重威胁还是一个不严重的威胁？

sentences.en: Okay, so threat assessment is all about collecting information from multiple sources using a multidisciplinary team.
sentences.zh: 好的，威胁评估的核心就是利用多学科团队从多个来源收集信息。

sentences.en: So it's not on the shoulders of one person to make this weighty decision, but with a multidisciplinary team, with school administration, school support staff that is counselors,
sentences.zh: 所以这个沉重的决定不应该压在某一个人肩上，而是要通过多学科团队，包括学校行政人员、学校支持人员（即辅导员、

sentences.en: psychologists, social workers.
sentences.zh: 心理学家、社工）。

sentences.en: And if they have a school resource officer, also the law enforcement officer, but all of them together will gather information.
sentences.zh: 如果他们有学校驻校警察，也会有执法人员参与，但他们所有人会在一起收集信息。

sentences.en: So we have an interview protocol for this student who's been identified as a student of concern.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们针对被确定为受关注学生的个体制定了一套访谈方案。

sentences.en: We have an interview that we use for witnesses and reporters of concern.
sentences.zh: 我们有一套用于目击者和举报人的访谈方案。

sentences.en: We look at the student's background and history, and depending on how complex and serious the threat is, we may be able to resolve it quickly and easily.
sentences.zh: 我们会查看学生的背景和历史，根据威胁的复杂和严重程度，我们或许能迅速轻松地解决它。

sentences.en: A student was just joking or they were expressing themselves in an exaggerated way.
sentences.zh: 也许某个学生只是在开玩笑，或者他们只是以夸张的方式表达自己。

sentences.en: But if there's reason to be more concerned, things don't quite add up where we're not really confident the young person is being straight with us,
sentences.zh: 但如果有理由让人更加担忧，情况有些说不通，或者我们对这个年轻人是否对我们坦诚没有太大把握，

sentences.en: then we do a more intensive assessment with more extensive interviewing and gathering of data.
sentences.zh: 那么我们就会进行更深入的评估，开展更广泛的访谈和数据收集。

sentences.en: We might involve law enforcement in some cases.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，我们可能会让执法部门介入。

sentences.en: We might conduct searches for weapons.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会搜查武器。

sentences.en: We might do a home visit.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会进行家访。

sentences.en: So our guidelines really have a kind of calibrated step-by-step approach.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的指南确实有一种经过精细校准的逐步推进的方法。

sentences.en: We have five steps, and some threats are resolved at step one, some at step two, some at step three, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 我们有五个步骤，有些威胁在第一步就解决了，有些在第二步，有些在第三步，依此类推。

sentences.en: So it's a calibrated process based on the complexity and seriousness of the case.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个根据案件的复杂性和严重程度来进行校准的过程。

sentences.en: What does the research say about how effective threat assessment is?
sentences.zh: 研究对威胁评估的有效性有何评价？

sentences.en: Do you have evidence that it's prevented school shootings, and are there other outcomes that you're looking for in your research?
sentences.zh: 你们是否有证据表明它预防了校园枪击案，除了这个之外，你们在研究中还关注哪些其他结果？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of outcomes that we're looking for.
sentences.zh: 所以我们关注的结果有很多。

sentences.en: We've done a half a dozen controlled studies involving hundreds of schools.
sentences.zh: 我们已经做过半打涉及数百所学校的对照研究。

sentences.en: We've done some implementation studies with thousands of schools.
sentences.zh: 我们还对数千所学校进行了实施研究。

sentences.en: And so we know that most cases can be resolved without removing the student from school, without expelling them, without arresting them.
sentences.zh: 因此我们知道，大多数案件都可以在不让学生离开学校、不勒令其退学、不逮捕他们的情况下得到解决。

sentences.en: And we can provide them services because we identify problems that they're having, peer conflicts and bullying.
sentences.zh: 我们可以为他们提供服务，因为我们发现了他们正在面临的问题、同伴冲突以及欺凌。

sentences.en: And we've got lots of data to show that that can be done.
sentences.zh: 我们有大量数据表明这是可以做到的。

sentences.en: It can be done effectively and safely.
sentences.zh: 而且可以做到既有效又安全。

sentences.en: Very few threats result in some kind of violent action.
sentences.zh: 极少数的威胁会导致某种暴力行动。

sentences.en: We've had some fights, but no shootings, thankfully, no homicides.
sentences.zh: 我们处理过一些打架斗殴，但谢天谢地，没有枪击案，也没有凶杀案。

sentences.en: But the question, of course, people want to ask is, well, have you prevented a school shooting?
sentences.zh: 但人们当然会问这样一个问题：好吧，你们预防了校园枪击案吗？

sentences.en: Well, certainly we have cases where students seem to have been very serious about committing a homicide, and they've been resolved, and we've had no homicides.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然我们确实遇到过这样的情况：有些学生似乎对实施谋杀非常认真，而这些情况得到了妥善解决，并且没有发生凶杀案。

sentences.en: But let me just say, scientifically, you need a randomized controlled trial.
sentences.zh: 但请允许我指出，从科学角度来说，你需要进行随机对照试验。

sentences.en: And school shootings are so rare.
sentences.zh: 而校园枪击案实在是太罕见了。

sentences.en: As I mentioned, fatal shootings are about once every 6,000 years for the average school.
sentences.zh: 正如我所提到的，对于平均水平的学校来说，致命枪击案大约每6000年发生一次。

sentences.en: If you think about that from a statistical point of view, you need thousands of schools that you're going to follow over multiple years
sentences.zh: 如果你从统计学的角度来考虑这一点，你需要追踪数千所学校长达多年，

sentences.en: to be able to demonstrate that you have reduced the rate of school shootings.
sentences.zh: 才能证明你降低了校园枪击案的发生率。

sentences.en: Because school shootings are quite statistically rare.
sentences.zh: 因为从统计学上看，校园枪击案相当罕见。

sentences.en: And so I can't claim that we've done a randomized controlled trial of school shootings,
sentences.zh: 因此，我不能声称我们对校园枪击案做过随机对照试验，

sentences.en: but we do have controlled studies to show that we can reduce a lot of conflicts and problems in schools.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实有对照研究表明，我们可以减少学校里的许多冲突和问题。

sentences.en: We can show that students feel safer in those schools, teachers feel safer in those schools, and about three-fourths of the students get referred for support services.
sentences.zh: 我们可以证明，学生在这些学校里感觉更安全，老师在这些学校里感觉更安全，而且大约四分之三的学生被转介接受了支持服务。

sentences.en: So we identify a lot of problems like bullying or peer conflicts or maybe mental health needs.
sentences.zh: 所以我们识别出了很多问题，比如霸凌、同伴冲突或潜在的心理健康需求。

sentences.en: We have a lot of kids with special education with disabilities that we need to make referrals to their special ed team to maybe enhance their program or their plan.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多有特殊教育需求的残疾儿童，我们需要将他们转介给他们的特教团队，以便或许能改进他们的项目或计划。

sentences.en: What are the roles of the various people within the school regarding threat assessment?
sentences.zh: 在威胁评估中，学校里各种人员的角色是什么？

sentences.en: For example, teachers, administrators, other students, what do they have to do to be effective in stopping school shootings before they happen?
sentences.zh: 例如，老师、行政人员、其他学生，他们必须做些什么才能在阻止校园枪击案发生方面发挥作用？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, safety is everyone's responsibility.
sentences.zh: 嗯，维护安全是每个人的责任。

sentences.en: Parents, teachers, students, support staff, everyone needs to be observant.
sentences.zh: 家长、老师、学生、支持人员，每个人都需要保持观察力。

sentences.en: And if they have concern, they need to report their concern.
sentences.zh: 如果他们有所担忧，就需要报告他们的担忧。

sentences.en: That's all they need to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们需要做的全部事情。

sentences.en: They don't need to do a threat assessment themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要自己去进行威胁评估。

sentences.en: They don't need to make a determination that someone is or is not dangerous.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要断定某人是否危险。

sentences.en: If they are concerned about something, the school should have multiple ways for them to report it.
sentences.zh: 如果他们对某事感到担忧，学校应该提供多种途径让他们进行报告。

sentences.en: Of course, we'd like them to just come forward and talk to a trusted adult.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们希望他们能直接站出来与信任的成年人交谈。

sentences.en: That's the most effective way.
sentences.zh: 这是最有效的方法。

sentences.en: But some schools will use an anonymous reporting system.
sentences.zh: 但有些学校会使用匿名举报系统。

sentences.en: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 这也可以。

sentences.en: It doesn't give as much information often as we would like.
sentences.zh: 它提供的信息通常不如我们希望的那么多。

sentences.en: But in any way that a concern can be reported, then the team, it's their responsibility to gather additional information
sentences.zh: 但无论通过什么方式报告担忧，团队都有责任收集额外信息，

sentences.en: and make that kind of determination about the seriousness of the threat.
sentences.zh: 并对威胁的严重程度做出那种判断。

sentences.en: But we need everyone in the school to understand that there's a process, that it's a fair, systematic process, that it gathers information.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要学校里的每个人都明白，这里有一个流程，这是一个公平、系统化的流程，它会收集信息。

sentences.en: And it's not going to mean that every student is removed from school.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着每个学生都会被开除出校。

sentences.en: That's kind of a problem we run to in threat assessment because, you know, parents and teachers and students are worried.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们在威胁评估中遇到的一个问题，因为你知道，家长、老师和学生都很担心。

sentences.en: And if a rumor gets out of hand and someone thinks that a student is dangerous, the first thing that people think is, well, let's get them out of the school.
sentences.zh: 如果谣言失控，有人认为某个学生很危险，人们首先想到的就是：好吧，让他们离开学校吧。

sentences.en: Let's remove them from the school.
sentences.zh: 把他们弄出学校。

sentences.en: That turns out not to be an effective safety response.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这并不是一个有效的安全应对措施。

sentences.en: And it's certainly not helpful to the student.
sentences.zh: 而且对这个学生也绝对没有任何帮助。

sentences.en: So we want to, in most cases, provide services and support, resolve a conflict, resolve an underlying problem.
sentences.zh: 所以在大多数情况下，我们希望提供服务和支持，化解冲突，解决根本问题。

sentences.en: And then move on from there.
sentences.zh: 然后在此基础上继续前进。

sentences.en: So if you're not going to remove a student, what are the alternatives?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你不打算将学生开除出校，还有什么替代方案？

sentences.en: What's something that does work when you're seeing a student who is problematic in that way?
sentences.zh: 当你遇到一个在那种方式上存在问题的学生时，有什么方法是真正管用的？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So every threat is different.
sentences.zh: 所以每个威胁都是不同的。

sentences.en: Sometimes a threat is just a joke and it can be resolved with an apology and clarification.
sentences.zh: 有时威胁只是个玩笑，可以通过道歉和澄清来解决。

sentences.en: Sometimes a threat is because somebody has had it with somebody and they're itching for a fight.
sentences.zh: 有时威胁是因为某人对另一个人忍无可忍，渴望打一架。

sentences.en: And so if you work in middle school, you know, middle school kids will get into fistfights.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在初中工作，你知道的，初中生会打群架。

sentences.en: And, you know, our school counselors and psychologists, they mediate conflicts between youngsters.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们的学校辅导员和心理学家会调解年轻人之间的冲突。

sentences.en: And we certainly want to support that.
sentences.zh: 我们当然希望支持这一点。

sentences.en: And it usually works.
sentences.zh: 而且通常很管用。

sentences.en: And what we found is that very few threat cases result in some kind of physical assault, about 5%.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，极少数威胁案件会导致某种形式的身体攻击，大约占5%。

sentences.en: And those are almost all fights, as I said.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，这些几乎全都是打架。

sentences.en: Very few injuries in the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州的受伤情况非常少。

sentences.en: We looked at 23,000 cases.
sentences.zh: 我们调查了23000起案件。

sentences.en: And we found, you know, almost all of them were resolved without any kind of assault or fight.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，你知道的，几乎所有案件都得到了解决，没有发生任何攻击或打架。

sentences.en: We had 10,000 cases where we looked at what kind of injury occurred and less than half of a percent had a serious injury where someone maybe had to go to the ER for some kind of injury.
sentences.zh: 我们调查了10000起案件中发生了哪种伤害，结果显示，不到百分之零点五的人受了重伤，可能有人因为某种伤害不得不去急诊室。

sentences.en: So those are very, very low rates.
sentences.zh: 所以这些比率非常非常低。

sentences.en: And most of the time, we're trying to draw upon the school's support services.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，我们都在努力利用学校的支持服务。

sentences.en: So a school might have multi-tiered systems of support.
sentences.zh: 因此，学校可能会有多层支持系统。

sentences.en: They certainly have special education services.
sentences.zh: 他们当然有特殊教育服务。

sentences.en: They may have PBIS.
sentences.zh: 他们可能有积极行为支持（PBIS）。

sentences.en: They may have restorative practices.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会采用修复性实践。

sentences.en: They may have anti-bullying prograMs.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会有反霸凌项目。

sentences.en: The whole range of support programs that we already have in schools can be selectively applied in most threat assessment cases.
sentences.zh: 我们学校现有的各种支持项目可以在大多数威胁评估案例中有选择地应用。

sentences.en: Now, I read a story in the newspaper just the other day about how students are using cell phones to spur violence and record each other having violent altercations.
sentences.zh: 刚才我在报纸上读到一则报道，讲的是学生如何使用手机煽动暴力并记录彼此的暴力冲突。

sentences.en: And yet, you're making it sound like it's not really a problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，你却把它说得好像根本不是什么大问题。

sentences.en: I mean, is it a problem?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个问题吗？

sentences.en: Are cell phones in school essentially spurring kids to act out more?
sentences.zh: 学校里的手机本质上是在怂恿孩子们做出更多越轨行为吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'm not trying to imply that we don't have a problem with student behavior in schools.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我并不是想暗示我们在学校里不存在学生行为问题。

sentences.en: And we've had some increase in aggressive behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们的攻击性行为确实有所增加。

sentences.en: And we have a lot of mental health concerns that, you know, we're not fully staffed in our schools to be able to manage.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多心理健康方面的担忧，你知道的，我们的学校人员配置不足，无法完全应对。

sentences.en: So I don't want to sound like I am dismissing the problem, but I'm saying the problem is not so much school shootings, which are terrible, but very rare.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想听起来像是在淡化这个问题，但我想说的是，问题与其说是校园枪击事件——虽然它们很可怕，但非常罕见——

sentences.en: But under the radar screen,
sentences.zh: 不如说是在暗地里，

sentences.en: we've got a lot of kids having conflicts and problems and bullying and those things we need to deal with with a lot of the evidence-based programs that the psychologists have developed for use in schools.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多孩子面临冲突、问题和霸凌，我们需要用心理学家为学校开发的大量循证项目来处理这些事情。

sentences.en: In the past several years, there's been a lot of debate about whether police officers, who are often called school resource officers, should be working in schools.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，关于通常被称为学校安全警官的警察是否应该在学校工作，有很多争论。

sentences.en: What's your view?
sentences.zh: 你的看法是什么？

sentences.en: What role should law enforcement play in school threat assessment?
sentences.zh: 执法部门在学校威胁评估中应该扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: Well, we've seen some cases where it seems that law enforcement has overreacted.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们看到一些案例，似乎执法部门反应过度了。

sentences.en: And after a high-profile shooting, we'll see cases of, you know, a 10-year-old being arrested or 12-year-old being arrested.
sentences.zh: 在发生备受瞩目的枪击事件后，我们会看到这样的案例，你知道的，一个10岁的孩子被捕了，或者12岁的孩子被捕了。

sentences.en: And in many of those cases, when we dig into the facts of what happened, it wasn't that severe an act.
sentences.zh: 在许多这样的案件中，当我们深入了解事情的真相时，发现它并不是那么严重的恶劣行径。

sentences.en: It didn't justify arrest or criminalization.
sentences.zh: 它并不足以构成逮捕或刑事指控。

sentences.en: Now, there are some cases where arrest is necessary, of course, but this has created a perception that maybe we need to get law enforcement out of schools.
sentences.zh: 当然，在某些情况下逮捕是必要的，但这给人一种印象，即也许我们需要让执法人员离开学校。

sentences.en: But I think the problem really arises when law enforcement are not in the schools working as part of the team.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，真正的问题出现在执法人员不在学校作为团队成员共同工作的时候。

sentences.en: So what we do in threat assessment is we want them to be part of the team.
sentences.zh: 所以在威胁评估中，我们希望他们成为团队的一部分。

sentences.en: We want them to go through the training.
sentences.zh: 我们希望他们接受培训。

sentences.en: We want them to understand the approach that we use.
sentences.zh: 我们希望他们理解我们使用的方法。

sentences.en: And we found that law enforcement is very receptive to this.
sentences.zh: 我们发现执法部门对此非常接受。

sentences.en: And when we have law enforcement as trained members of the team, we get very good results.
sentences.zh: 当我们将执法人员作为经过培训的团队成员时，我们取得了非常好的效果。

sentences.en: Fewer than 1% of the students are arrested.
sentences.zh: 不到1%的学生被捕。

sentences.en: And law enforcement officers in schools can have a positive effect when they're not enforcing discipline but being role models and counselors and sources of support in the school.
sentences.zh: 当学校里的执法人员不强制执行纪律，而是充当榜样、辅导员和学校的支持源泉时，他们就能产生积极的影响。

sentences.en: Now, I am concerned that, you know, law enforcement officers might not be adequately trained or prepared or selected to work in schools.
sentences.zh: 不过，我确实担心，你知道的，执法人员可能没有接受过充分的培训、准备或挑选来在学校工作。

sentences.en: So we've got a lot of work to do to improve that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还有很多工作要做来改进这一点。

sentences.en: But I certainly think putting them out of schools is a recipe for trouble.
sentences.zh: 但我当然认为把他们赶出学校是自找麻烦。

sentences.en: Many schools have found that when the officers were removed, who's going to break up the fight?
sentences.zh: 许多学校发现，当警官被撤走后，谁来拉开打架的人？

sentences.en: If you have a melee in the school, in the lobby, are you asking the history teacher to step into harm's way and do something about it?
sentences.zh: 如果你在学校大厅里遇到一场混战，难道你要叫历史老师挺身而出，去管这事吗？

sentences.en: And, of course, students also, in our surveys, the vast majority of students feel that the presence of the school's resource officer makes them feel safer in the school.
sentences.zh: 当然，根据我们的调查，绝大多数学生也认为，学校安全警官的存在让他们在学校里感到更安全。

sentences.en: Now, this is across racial groups.
sentences.zh: 而且，这跨越了不同的种族群体。

sentences.en: This is true for Black, Hispanic, white, other racial groups.
sentences.zh: 黑人、西班牙裔、白人和其他种族群体都是如此。

sentences.en: We've done statewide surveys of that.
sentences.zh: 我们已经做过全州范围的调查。

sentences.en: I know there are situations where things have gone poorly, where we need to have interventions to make things go better.
sentences.zh: 我知道有些情况下事情处理得不好，我们需要进行干预以让事情变得更好。

sentences.en: But on the whole, I think law enforcement can be a positive force in schools if they're well-trained, supervised, have a well-defined role.
sentences.zh: 但总体而言，我认为如果执法人员经过良好培训、监督并拥有明确定义的角色，他们可以成为学校的一股积极力量。

sentences.en: And, yes, I am concerned about the students with cell phones who are taking images of fights and putting them on the Internet.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实担心那些拿着手机拍摄打架画面并将其发到网上的学生。

sentences.en: And that has a great contagious effect.
sentences.zh: 这产生了巨大的传染效应。

sentences.en: Everybody wants to get in on the act and be part of doing something as sensational as that.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想参与其中，去做一些同样轰动的事情。

sentences.en: So we have to do a lot of education with our students around the hazards of social media, around appropriate behavior.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须围绕社交媒体的危害以及适当的行为对学生进行大量的教育。

sentences.en: And we need to have some restrictions on the use of cell phones in our schools.
sentences.zh: 我们需要对学校里手机的使用进行一些限制。

sentences.en: You mentioned a moment ago about sometimes overreacting by law enforcement and arresting 10-year-olds or younger children who really are not seriously threatening.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到执法部门有时反应过度，逮捕了10岁或更小的、实际上并未构成严重威胁的儿童。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering whether threat assessment works differently for different ages or grade levels.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，针对不同的年龄或年级水平，威胁评估的运作方式是否有所不同？

sentences.en: I mean, how should a school respond to a threat from a very young child like in elementary school?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，面对像小学这样非常小的孩子的威胁，学校该如何回应？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, you always have to consider the child's age, their developmental level.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你总是必须考虑孩子的年龄和他们的发展水平。

sentences.en: If they have a disability or any other kind of mental health or educational condition, you have to consider that to understand where they're coming from, what they meant,
sentences.zh: 如果他们有残疾或其他任何心理健康或教育状况，你必须考虑这些因素，以了解他们的想法、他们的意图，

sentences.en: and what they're capable of doing.
sentences.zh: 以及他们有能力做什么。

sentences.en: We actually have more threat assessments conducted in elementary school than we do in secondary school.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们在小学进行的威胁评估比在中学进行的还要多。

sentences.en: There's more of those kids, and they're immature, and they will say and do things impulsively because of their age.
sentences.zh: 那里的孩子更多，他们不够成熟，由于年龄原因，他们会冲动地说出和做出一些事情。

sentences.en: And in most of the cases, the vast majority, 80% of those cases, it's resolved is what we call a transient threat that's not serious.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，绝大多数——占80%的案件中——它被解决为我们所说的瞬时威胁，并不严重。

sentences.en: As kids get older into middle and secondary school, they're a little less impulsive.
sentences.zh: 当孩子们长大进入初中和中等学校时，他们没有那么冲动了。

sentences.en: They make fewer threats, but those threats have a little bit more concern behind them because they're more capable of injuring someone.
sentences.zh: 他们发出的威胁少了，但这些威胁背后的担忧稍微多了一些，因为他们更有能力伤害别人。

sentences.en: And so we have to adjust the threat assessment process to the age of the child.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须根据孩子的年龄调整威胁评估流程。

sentences.en: And, of course, by using a school-based team, we're able to do that because we want the folks who are in the school,
sentences.zh: 当然，通过使用以学校为基础的团队，我们能够做到这一点，因为我们希望身处学校内部的人员，

sentences.en: who are familiar with their school, their students, the culture of their school,
sentences.zh: 熟悉他们的学校、学生以及学校文化的人，

sentences.en: we want them making these decisions rather than maybe an authority from outside who's using a uniform set of standards.
sentences.zh: 来做这些决定，而不是由采用统一标准的外部权威来决定。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, it's a big difference between an 8-year-old saying something and a 16-year-old saying something.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道的，8岁孩子说的话和16岁孩子说的话有很大区别。

sentences.en: And our expectations for their behavior are different.
sentences.zh: 我们对他们行为的期望是不同的。

sentences.en: And, unfortunately, if law enforcement or, you know, outside authorities of any kind are applying a strict uniform standard that doesn't consider the age of the student,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，如果执法部门或任何外部权威机构采用了不考虑学生年龄的严格统一标准，

sentences.en: there's a potential for overreaction there.
sentences.zh: 那就存在反应过度的潜在可能。

sentences.en: Well, how can schools avoid underreacting to serious threats and overreacting to unserious threats?
sentences.zh: 那么，学校如何才能既避免对严重威胁反应不足，又避免对不严重的威胁反应过度呢？

sentences.en: Well, that's why they need an evidence-based threat assessment program.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他们需要一个循证威胁评估项目。

sentences.en: It's a systematic way to gather information, share it with colleagues, and make a reasonable decision.
sentences.zh: 这是一种收集信息、与同事分享并做出合理决定的系统化方法。

sentences.en: Threat assessment isn't perfect.
sentences.zh: 威胁评估并不是完美的。

sentences.en: It's not guaranteed to always be correct.
sentences.zh: 它不能保证总是百分之百正确。

sentences.en: But what we found is that we can dramatically reduce removing kids from school, kids being punished rather than helped.
sentences.zh: 但我们发现，我们可以大大减少让学生退学、惩罚学生而不是帮助学生的情况。

sentences.en: And that's very important because, as I said, almost no school will ever have a shooting.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要，因为正如我所说，几乎没有哪所学校会真正发生枪击事件。

sentences.en: But every school is having students make threats.
sentences.zh: 但每所学校都有学生发出威胁。

sentences.en: And so there's a big problem there if we were to apply zero tolerance.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们实行零容忍政策，就会产生很大的问题。

sentences.en: And many schools use zero tolerance.
sentences.zh: 许多学校都在使用零容忍政策。

sentences.en: They say, you've broken the rule regardless of the circumstances, regardless of your age, whatever.
sentences.zh: 他们说，无论情况如何，无论你的年龄多大，不管怎样，你都违反了规则。

sentences.en: We're going to remove you from school.
sentences.zh: 我们要把你开除出校。

sentences.en: And what research has found is that, you know, removing kids from school doesn't improve their behavior.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，你知道的，把学生赶出学校并不能改善他们的行为。

sentences.en: It doesn't make the school safer.
sentences.zh: 它不会让学校变得更安全。

sentences.en: It increases the likelihood that the student is going to misbehave and drop out of school down the road.
sentences.zh: 它反而增加了该学生日后行为不端和辍学的可能性。

sentences.en: So we want to be very careful about using school removal.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在使用开除出校时必须非常谨慎。

sentences.en: I would remove a student from school when it's just really clearly not safe and it's in the child's best interest to have a different,
sentences.zh: 只有在确实非常不安全、且对孩子而言采用不同、

sentences.en: more structured and supportive environment than the regular classroom or the regular school.
sentences.zh: 更有条理和支持性的环境（而不是常规课堂或常规学校）才最符合其最佳利益时，我才会将学生开除出校。

sentences.en: But what we have found is that in the vast majority of cases, that's not necessary.
sentences.zh: 但我们发现，在绝大多数情况下，这是没有必要的。

sentences.en: Is there anybody in this whole mix who is more critical or pivotal than anybody else?
sentences.zh: 在这个复杂的群体中，有没有哪个人比其他人更具决定性或更为关键？

sentences.en: Is it other students who report the threats or teachers or guidance counselors or even parents?
sentences.zh: 是举报威胁的其他学生、老师、辅导顾问，甚至是家长吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, when it comes to reporting concerns, we want everybody to know how and be willing and to see the difference between snitching and seeking help.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在举报担忧方面，我们希望所有人都知道如何做、愿意去做，并且能够看出打小报告与寻求帮助之间的区别。

sentences.en: But what we have found when we study school shootings, school shootings that have occurred and school shootings that have averted,
sentences.zh: 但我们在研究校园枪击事件（包括已经发生的和被阻止的校园枪击事件）时发现，

sentences.en: that usually it's a student who has key information, who knows something.
sentences.zh: 通常是某个学生掌握了关键信息，了解一些内情。

sentences.en: And so we very much want to encourage student reporting and students are going to be more willing to report when there are trusted adults in the school,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们非常希望鼓励学生举报，而当学校里有值得信赖的成年人时，学生会更愿意举报，

sentences.en: when they have confidence that the adults in their school have their best interest at heart,
sentences.zh: 当他们相信学校里的成年人真心为他们的利益着想时，

sentences.en: that aren't going to simply take a zero tolerance approach, that the school climate is that discipline is fair and that they are treated with respect.
sentences.zh: 当他们相信学校不会简单地采取零容忍态度、学校的纪律风气是公平的并且他们受到了尊重时，他们会更愿意举报。

sentences.en: We've actually done a number of studies of what makes students willing to report a threat and a positive school climate,
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们做过大量研究，探讨是什么让学生愿意举报威胁，以及积极的学校风气——

sentences.en: what we call an authoritative school climate, not authoritarian, but authoritative.
sentences.zh: 我们称之为权威型的学校风气，不是专制型，而是权威型。

sentences.en: That is, they feel that the rules are strict but fair and that the adults at school support them and respect them and have their best interest at heart.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他们觉得规则严格但公平，学校的成年人支持他们、尊重他们并且真心为他们的利益着想。

sentences.en: That kind of climate is what we want to see in our schools.
sentences.zh: 这种风气正是我们希望在学校里看到的。

sentences.en: And then students are willing to report threats.
sentences.zh: 这样，学生才愿意举报威胁。

sentences.en: Parents are willing to report threats as well.
sentences.zh: 家长也愿意举报威胁。

sentences.en: And I've worked on a number of cases where that was really critical information.
sentences.zh: 我曾参与过多起案件，其中的关键信息正是来源于此。

sentences.en: What is your view of active shooter drills?
sentences.zh: 你对现行枪击应急演练（active shooter drills）有何看法？

sentences.en: I mean, many schools are requiring them now and they're trying to teach students how to respond to an active shooter in the building.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在许多学校都强制要求进行这类演练，并试图教导学生如何在建筑物内应对枪手。

sentences.en: Now, you've talked about how unusual shootings are in schools.
sentences.zh: 既然你已经谈到了校园枪击事件是多么罕见，

sentences.en: Should we be doing this?
sentences.zh: 我们还应该这样做吗？

sentences.en: I mean, this traumatizes a lot of kids.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这给许多孩子带来了心理创伤。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, I am very concerned about active shooter drills, particularly the ones that involve some kind of reenactment, some kind of simulation,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我对现行枪击应急演练非常担忧，特别是那些涉及某种情景重现、某种模拟的演练，

sentences.en: ones that involve weapons being displayed or people being simulated, being shot or attacked.
sentences.zh: 那些涉及展示武器或模拟人员被枪击或袭击的演练。

sentences.en: I think those are harmful and not helpful.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些是有害的，毫无帮助。

sentences.en: I think some training and orientation of staff about how to deal with an intruder.
sentences.zh: 我认为对员工进行一些如何应对入侵者的培训和指导是有必要的。

sentences.en: And most of the time, the intruder is not going to be an active shooter.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，入侵者不会是带着枪的枪手。

sentences.en: There are other kinds of incidents that schools have to deal with, someone coming into the building that shouldn't be there.
sentences.zh: 学校还必须处理其他类型的事件，比如有人闯入本不该进入的建筑物。

sentences.en: So there are reasons to practice security in a school.
sentences.zh: 因此，在学校里练习安全防范是有理由的。

sentences.en: But I think the reenactments and the simulations have gone too far.
sentences.zh: 但我认为情景重现和模拟已经太过火了。

sentences.en: I think if law enforcement wants to practice their SWAT procedures, that should be done on a weekend when there aren't students present.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果执法部门想练习他们的特警（SWAT）程序，应该在周末没有学生在场的时候进行。

sentences.en: I think trying to practice something live is going too far.
sentences.zh: 我认为尝试进行实况演练是太过火了。

sentences.en: And the same is true for a lot of security measures.
sentences.zh: 许多安全措施也是如此。

sentences.en: You know, schools are spending literally billions of dollars nationwide on high-tech security measures, panic buttons, facial recognition, gunshot detectors, metal detectors,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，全国各地的学校在昂贵的高科技安全措施上花费了数以十亿计的美元——恐慌按钮、面部识别、枪击探测器、金属探测器、

sentences.en: bullet-resistant glass, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 防弹玻璃等等。

sentences.en: And these are extraordinarily expensive.
sentences.zh: 这些费用极其昂贵。

sentences.en: And at the same time, these same schools don't have enough school counselors.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这些学校却没有足够的学校辅导员。

sentences.en: They have one school psychologist covering five schools.
sentences.zh: 他们可能一个学校心理学家要负责五所学校。

sentences.en: They're understaffed.
sentences.zh: 他们人手严重不足。

sentences.en: And so their ability to implement prevention programs and to build relationships with students where we can get information that can prevent and head off a shooting,
sentences.zh: 因此，他们实施预防项目以及与学生建立关系的能力大打折扣，而通过这些关系我们可以获取信息来预防和遏制枪击事件，

sentences.en: that's a huge gap.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的差距。

sentences.en: So we need a better balance between security and prevention.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要在安全和预防之间取得更好的平衡。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, the emphasis on these high-profile shootings that are very dramatic and troubling and distressing,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，对这些高度引人注目、非常戏剧化、令人烦恼和痛苦的枪击事件的过分强调，

sentences.en: that leads people to make an emotional decision and school boards to make an emotional decision that says, all right, let's batten down the hatches.
sentences.zh: 导致人们做出情绪化的决定，导致学校董事会做出情绪化的决定，说：好吧，让我们严阵以待吧。

sentences.en: Let's make our school building, you know, into a fortress.
sentences.zh: 让我们把学校大楼变成一座堡垒。

sentences.en: But I think the return on investment for that is not very good.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这样做的投资回报率并不是很高。

sentences.en: If you want to take an economic perspective, and from a psychological perspective,
sentences.zh: 如果你从经济角度和心理学角度来看的话

sentences.en: it's not a very good return in terms of building trust in our students and having enough staff to work with our students.
sentences.zh: 在建立学生信任以及配备足够的工作人员来与学生合作方面，这并不是一个很好的回报。

sentences.en: Let me mention one other fact that people sometimes overlook.
sentences.zh: 让我提另一个人们有时会忽视的事实。

sentences.en: They're focused on the idea of a shooting in the building.
sentences.zh: 他们专注于大楼里发生枪击事件的想法。

sentences.en: So they try to lock down the building.
sentences.zh: 所以他们试图封锁大楼。

sentences.en: They try to keep everybody out of the building.
sentences.zh: 他们试图把所有人挡在大楼外面。

sentences.en: They try to lock all the doors in the building.
sentences.zh: 他们试图锁上大楼里所有的门。

sentences.en: But, you know, if we look at school shootings that have occurred, only 30 percent of school shootings occurred in the building.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，如果我们看看已经发生的校园枪击案，只有百分之三十的校园枪击案发生在建筑物内部。

sentences.en: So it's the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 所以它发生在停车场。

sentences.en: It's the football game.
sentences.zh: 它发生在足球比赛中。

sentences.en: It's places outside of the school, which is consistent with gun violence in general.
sentences.zh: 它发生在学校以外的地方，这与普遍的枪支暴力是一致的。

sentences.en: Gun violence is more common in these other environments than in the building.
sentences.zh: 与其他环境相比，枪支暴力在这些其他环境中更为常见，而不是在建筑物内部。

sentences.en: So if we're concerned about security, just making the building secure is not a good expenditure of funds because the shooting is more likely to occur outside of the building.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们关心安全，仅仅保证建筑物的安全并不是一笔划算的资金开支，因为枪击事件更有可能发生在建筑物外部。

sentences.en: And actually, if you have a young person that you're concerned might be potentially violent, they're much more likely to shoot somebody outside of school.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你有一个你担心可能具有潜在暴力的年轻人，他们更有可能在学校外面向某人开枪。

sentences.en: So if we've got a counselor, if we've got a psychologist, if we have a social worker working with a young person that we're concerned about,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们有一个辅导员，如果我们有一个心理学家，如果我们有一个社会工作者与我们所关心的年轻人一起工作，

sentences.en: I would rather be focusing on preventing them from committing a shooting anywhere in the community rather than just the idea that we can prevent them from doing it in the hallway of one particular building.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿把重点放在防止他们在社区的任何地方犯罪，而不仅仅是我们能防止他们在某栋特定建筑物的走廊里犯罪的想法上。

sentences.en: So I think we've got to think more broadly about prevention here and less narrowly about turning the school building into a fortress.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们必须对这里的预防工作有更广泛的思考，而不要狭隘地把学校建筑变成一座堡垒。

sentences.en: I think a lot of what you're saying will give hope to our listeners, you know, many of whom are parents,
sentences.zh: 我想你所说的大部分内容会给我们的听众带来希望，你知道，他们中的许多人都是父母，

sentences.en: that they don't have to worry as much as perhaps they are about sending their kids to school.
sentences.zh: 他们不必像现在这样担心把孩子送到学校去。

sentences.en: So let me tell you one thing that I like to tell parents,
sentences.zh: 所以让我告诉你们一件事，我喜欢告诉家长，

sentences.en: and it's kind of a hard message to get to them when they've thought about school shootings and they imagined how horrible it is.
sentences.zh: 当他们想到校园枪击案并想象它是多么可怕时，这是一种很难传达给他们的信息。

sentences.en: And, you know, I had three children in the public schools.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我有三个孩子在公立学校上学。

sentences.en: I've got grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 我有孙辈。

sentences.en: So I'm certainly able to look at this from a parent's perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以我当然能够从父母的角度来看待这个问题。

sentences.en: But I know scientifically that if a parent is afraid to send their child to school because they think of the risk the child could be shot,
sentences.zh: 但我从科学上知道，如果一个家长因为担心孩子被枪击的风险而不敢把孩子送到学校去，

sentences.en: then that parent logically should never let their child go to a restaurant, never let their child go into a convenience store,
sentences.zh: 那么这位家长在逻辑上也绝不应该让孩子去餐馆，绝不应该让孩子去便利店，

sentences.en: never let their child go into a parking lot or a park.
sentences.zh: 绝不应该让孩子去停车场或公园。

sentences.en: Because those areas have double, triple, quadruple the shootings that school buildings have.
sentences.zh: 因为那些区域的枪击事件是学校建筑的两倍、三倍、四倍。

sentences.en: Schools, ironically, are safe havens in many, many communities with high crime.
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，在许多犯罪率高的社区，学校是安全的避风港。

sentences.en: Schools are the safest places for our kids to be.
sentences.zh: 学校是我们孩子呆的最安全的地方。

sentences.en: And I know it's hard because as a parent, you know, we can imagine those school shootings and they're so horrendous and we've got to do everything we can to prevent them.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很难，因为作为父母，你知道，我们可以想象那些校园枪击事件，它们是如此可怕，我们必须尽一切努力去阻止它们。

sentences.en: But we've got to prevent the shootings that occur all over our society.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须防止在我们整个社会发生的枪击事件。

sentences.en: We have about 300 shootings every day in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们每天大约有三百起枪击事件。

sentences.en: We have over 100 people killed by gunfire every day in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们每天有超过一百人死于枪击。

sentences.en: We just don't hear about those cases.
sentences.zh: 我们只是没有听说过这些案子。

sentences.en: We hear about the ones in the school building that are so heartrending, so heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 我们听说的是学校里那些令人心碎、令人痛心的案子。

sentences.en: But less than 2% of homicides of school-age people occur in schools.
sentences.zh: 但学龄人群凶杀案中只有不到百分之二发生在学校里。

sentences.en: Less than 2% of the homicides occur in school.
sentences.zh: 不到百分之二的凶杀案发生在学校。

sentences.en: 98% occur outside of school.
sentences.zh: 百分之九十八发生在学校外面。

sentences.en: So I want measures that focus on protecting all of our kids and not just in the confines of the school building.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要关注保护我们所有孩子的措施，而不仅仅是在学校建筑的范围内。

sentences.en: So just to wrap up, what's next for you in your research?
sentences.zh: 那么总结一下，你接下来在研究中要做什么？

sentences.en: What are the questions you're still trying to answer?
sentences.zh: 你还在试图回答什么问题？

sentences.en: Well, oh gosh, there's lots of questions because we want to make this training program effective.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，有很多问题，因为我们希望这个培训计划能够有效。

sentences.en: We want to make the implementation effective.
sentences.zh: 我们希望使实施有效。

sentences.en: We want to make sure it's fair and equitable.
sentences.zh: 我们希望确保它是公平和公正的。

sentences.en: So we've done a number of studies on that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这方面做过许多研究。

sentences.en: We currently have a national study with districts from six states implementing the C-STAG model.
sentences.zh: 我们目前正在进行一项全国性研究，由来自六个州的学区实施 C-STAG 模型。

sentences.en: We're measuring the fidelity of implementation.
sentences.zh: 我们正在衡量实施的保真度。

sentences.en: That is, how high quality are they following the procedure?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他们遵循程序的质量有多高？

sentences.en: Because schools have limited resources and staff are often, you know, burdened with lots of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 因为学校资源有限，员工往往，你知道，背负着沉重的责任。

sentences.en: So what can we do to make sure that they follow the threat assessment protocol fully?
sentences.zh: 那么我们能做些什么来确保他们完全遵循威胁评估协议呢？

sentences.en: And if they do, do they get better results?
sentences.zh: 如果他们这样做了，他们会得到更好的结果吗？

sentences.en: We want to show that.
sentences.zh: 我们想证明这一点。

sentences.en: We also want to show the equity and fairness of threat assessment.
sentences.zh: 我们还想展示威胁评估的公平和公正。

sentences.en: I know in school discipline, black students are removed from school at disproportionate rates, about double the rates of white students for school discipline in general.
sentences.zh: 我知道在学校纪律方面，黑人学生被开除出学校的比例不成比例，大约是白人学生一般学校纪律比例的两倍。

sentences.en: What we found with threat assessment is that disparity shrinks almost to zero.
sentences.zh: 我们在威胁评估中发现，这种差距几乎缩小到零。

sentences.en: Our differences in our latest study between white and black students were about 2%, not 200%, 2%.
sentences.zh: 在我们最新的研究中，白人学生和黑人学生之间的差异约为百分之二，而不是百分之二百，是百分之二。

sentences.en: So we're getting very equitable outcomes across racial groups, also across groups defined by disability.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在各个种族群体以及由残疾定义的群体中获得了非常公平的结果。

sentences.en: We know that in the United States, students with disabilities get removed from school at one and a half to double the rate of other students without disabilities,
sentences.zh: 我们知道在美国，残疾学生被学校开除的比例是其他没有残疾的学生的一点五倍到两倍，

sentences.en: but not with a threat assessment.
sentences.zh: 但威胁评估不是这样的。

sentences.en: If we can route those students into a threat assessment, their outcomes are no different, no different than the students without disabilities.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能把这些学生引导到威胁评估中，他们的结果将没有什么不同，与没有残疾的学生没有区别。

sentences.en: Same for families with low income.
sentences.zh: 低收入家庭也是如此。

sentences.en: We know that low income families often get fewer services and more punishment.
sentences.zh: 我们知道低收入家庭往往得到的服务较少，受到的惩罚较多。

sentences.en: But in large scale studies of threat assessment, we find they're treated comparably.
sentences.zh: 但在大规模的威胁评估研究中，我们发现他们得到了平等的对待。

sentences.en: So we're very optimistic that we can get some very positive benefits from students.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们非常乐观地认为，我们可以从学生身上获得一些非常积极的好处。

sentences.en: Quite apart from the horror of a school shooting, we can discipline students in a more equitable manner.
sentences.zh: 撇开校园枪击案的可怕性不谈，我们可以以更公平的方式管教学生。

sentences.en: And in most cases, 75% of the cases, they're receiving services rather than being put out of school.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，百分之七十五的情况下，他们接受的是服务，而不是被赶出学校。

sentences.en: Well, Dr. Cornell, I want to thank you for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 那么，康奈尔博士，我要感谢你今天能来。

sentences.en: This has been very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这非常有趣。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你提供这个机会。

sentences.en: I'm happy to follow up if anyone has questions, wants to contact me.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何人有问题或想联系我，我很高兴进行后续交流。

sentences.en: We've got lots of research and materials to share.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多研究和材料可以分享。

sentences.en: Oh, great.
sentences.zh: 哦，太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 您可以在我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org 上，或在 Apple、Spotify、YouTube 或您获取播客的任何地方找到往期的《心理学说话》节目。

sentences.en: And if you like what you've heard, please subscribe and leave us a review.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢你所听到的，请订阅并给我们留下评论。

sentences.en: For those of you who want to know more about psychology and the work of APA, you can join us as a supporter.
sentences.zh: 对于那些想更多了解心理学和美国心理学协会工作的人，您可以作为支持者加入我们。

sentences.en: You don't have to be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 你不需要成为一名心理学家。

sentences.en: The benefits include a subscription to our award-winning magazine, Monitor on Psychology, as well as discounts on our books and other publications.
sentences.zh: 福利包括订阅我们屡获殊荣的杂志《心理学观察》，以及我们书籍和其他出版物的折扣。

sentences.en: So if psychology is your passion or if you just want to know more about the science and discipline, you can become a supporter by visiting at.apa.org slash speaking.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果心理学是您的热情所在，或者您只是想更多地了解科学和学科，您可以通过访问 at.apa.org slash speaking 成为支持者。

sentences.en: That's A-T as in Tom, .apa.org slash speaking.
sentences.zh: 即 Tom 的 A-T，.apa.org 斜杠 speaking。

sentences.en: If you have comments, questions, or ideas for future podcasts, email us at speakingofpsychology at apa.org.
sentences.zh: 如果您对未来的播客有任何意见、问题或想法，请发电子邮件至 speakingofpsychology at apa.org。

sentences.en: Speaking of Psychology is produced by Lee Weinerman.
sentences.zh: 《心理学说话》由李·韦纳曼制作。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢收听。

sentences.en: For the American Psychological Association, I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯，代表美国心理学协会。
